planes.faq.title: Before signing up.
planes.faq.q1: Is there a minimum contract term?
planes.faq.a1: No. All plans are billed monthly and you can cancel with 30 days' notice.
planes.faq.a2: Custom. We assess number of devices, users, critical systems and desired SLAs. We send you a quote in under 48 hours.
planes.faq.a3: Yes, at any time. We make a proportional adjustment on the next invoice.
planes.faq.q4: Do you serve outside Río Cuarto?
planes.faq.a4: We work across Argentina. Remote support always; on-site support depending on location.
planes.faq.a5: Every emergency is handled. The SLA defines the response commitment, not the limit of support.

nosotros.lede: We are a team of professionals in maintenance, software development and connectivity. We work with companies that need technology that works, all the time, no excuses.
nosotros.manifesto.title: How we think.
nosotros.manifesto.01.d: A well-maintained system doesn't need rescuing. We invest time in prevention and monitoring so that emergencies are the exception.
nosotros.manifesto.02.d: We speak plain language. If a solution can't be explained, it's probably not the best solution.
nosotros.manifesto.03.d: Better to maintain than to patch. We work in review and improvement cycles, not isolated heroics.
nosotros.manifesto.04.d: We measure, report and decide based on evidence. Intuition helps, but numbers rule.
